description: This file is a shell script for testing 'git apply' functionality with various options like --3way, --index, --cached, conflict styles, and binary patches. It includes setup steps, various test cases, and expected outcomes related to patch application and conflict handling.

methods.name: print_sanitized_conflicted_diff
methods.description: Outputs the current git diff in a sanitized format, removing index lines and adjusting conflict markers for easier comparison during tests.

methods.name: test_apply_with_3way
methods.description: Tests applying a patch with --3way option, comparing the diff and merge results for consistency.

methods.name: test_apply_with_3way_favoritism
methods.description: Tests applying patches with --3way option and different strategies (--ours, --theirs, --union), verifying the resulting file states and diff consistency.
